Each kind of broken or unsafe link is reported: missing local targets, root-absolute paths (they break under
the Pages subpath), paths leaving site/, unpinned libraries and plain http.
source: @pytest.mark.req("PUB-03") @pytest.mark.parametrize("bad, expect", [ ('x', "does not exist"), ('', "does not exist"), ('x', "root-absolute"), ('x', "outside site/"), ('', "unpinned"), ('', "insecure"), ]) def test_link_check_catches_bad_links(tmp_path, bad, expect): """Each kind of broken or unsafe link is reported: missing local targets, root-absolute paths (they break under the Pages subpath), paths leaving site/, unpinned libraries and plain http.""" (tmp_path / "outside.html").write_text("x", encoding="utf-8") problems = P.link_problems(fake_site(tmp_path, GOOD.format(bad))) assert any(expect in p for p in problems), problems
